name: Precision PCB | Precision Technologies, Inc.
old_description: Quick Turn PCB and Assembly by Certified Manufacturing Experts -
about:
Precision Technologies, Inc., operating as Precision PCB, is headquartered in Elgin, Illinois. The company was founded in 1998 and has provided electronics manufacturing services for over 25 years.

The company offers a full suite of PCB services including design, fabrication, and assembly. Its fabrication capabilities cover single-sided, double-sided, and multilayer boards up to rigid-flex and HDI constructions, as well as RF/microwave and semiconductor PCBs. Assembly services include surface-mount placement down to 0201 passives, through-hole, mixed-technology, and leadless packages such as BGA, QFN, and LGA, all inspected to IPC-A-610 Class III. Production spans prototype through medium-volume runs, leveraging both domestic and offshore facilities.

Precision PCB serves customers in defense and aerospace, medical devices, automotive, LED lighting, industrial equipment, test and measurement, transportation, and networking and AI infrastructure. Its client base ranges from engineering teams needing quick-turn prototypes to buyers managing scheduled production deliveries.

The company emphasizes a "One-Stop Solution" model with a single point of contact from sales through delivery, aiming to eliminate communication gaps and engineering delays. It holds ITAR registration (CAGE 7T6D9) and ISO 9001:2015 certification, and advertises quick-turn capabilities such as next-morning delivery for double-sided boards ordered by 9 a.m. EST, 48-hour multilayer turns, and 24- to 48-hour prototype assembly.
